unitTitle: Organise work, study and future plans
title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 5: Organise work, study and future plans

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: La formation du soir commence le 4 novembre. La date limite pour envoyer le formulaire est le 28 octobre.
steps.question: What is the last day to send the form?
steps.explain: The speaker gives October 28 as the deadline.

steps.fr: Je vais participer à l'entretien vendredi matin. Si l'heure change, la conseillère va m'envoyer un courriel.
steps.question: What will the adviser do if the time changes?
steps.explain: The speaker says the adviser will email if the time changes.

steps.fr: Nous choisirons le groupe après l'entretien. La formation va commencer en janvier.
steps.question: When will the course begin?
steps.explain: The recording says the course will start in January.

steps.fr: Je ne vais pas suivre le cours intensif cet été. Je vais m'inscrire à la formation du soir en septembre.
steps.question: Which course will the speaker enrol in?
steps.explain: The speaker plans to enrol in the evening course in September.

steps.fr: Votre candidature restera en attente jusqu'à lundi. Nous allons confirmer la date de l'entretien par courriel.
steps.question: How will the interview date be confirmed?
steps.explain: The notice says the date will be confirmed by email.
